data.name: alpine_title
data.value: 1. Technical Development Report: Alpine Skiing (Foundever Games)

data.name: alpine_s1_title
data.value: Unity Engine Architecture & Physics Pipeline

data.name: alpine_s1_p1
data.value: The development of Alpine Skiing within the Unity ecosystem relies on a optimized C# script architecture tailored for continuous motion and high-frequency collision detection.

data.name: alpine_s1_li1_title
data.value: Rigidbodies & Kinematics:

data.name: alpine_s1_li1_text
data.value: The skier character leverages a hybrid kinematic-dynamic controller. Gravity and forward momentum vectors are dynamically modulated via custom physics scripts to simulate realistic snow resistance and slope inclination.

data.name: alpine_s1_li2_title
data.value: Terrain & Procedural Generation:

data.name: alpine_s1_li2_text
data.value: Unity's Terrain Engine is utilized alongside mesh colliders optimized for WebGL deployment. Level chunks instantiate dynamically to maintain a stable frame rate, reducing memory garbage collection overhead during extended gaming sessions.

data.name: alpine_s1_li3_title
data.value: Input Management:

data.name: alpine_s1_li3_text
data.value: Direct mapping to keyboard and touch events via Unity's Input System package, ensuring zero-latency translation of user steering commands.

data.name: alpine_s2_title
data.value: Visual Art & 3D Asset Pipeline

data.name: alpine_s2_p1
data.value: The visual identity of Alpine Skiing balances performance optimization with stylized aesthetic appeal, tailored for browser-based delivery.

data.name: alpine_s2_li1_title
data.value: Low-Poly & Asset Optimization:

data.name: alpine_s2_li1_text
data.value: 3D environments, trees, and obstacles are constructed using low-polygon modeling techniques in Blender, followed by normal map baking to preserve surface detail without polygon inflation.

data.name: alpine_s2_li2_title
data.value: Shaders & Environment FX:

data.name: alpine_s2_li2_text
data.value: Custom Unlit and Toon shaders are implemented to manage lighting and ambient occlusion efficiently, ensuring high visual clarity even on standard hardware.

data.name: alpine_s2_li3_title
data.value: Lighting & Post-Processing:

data.name: alpine_s2_li3_text
data.value: Forward rendering path combined with lightweight baked lightmaps to simulate crisp alpine daylight without taxing GPU resources during active employee breaks.

data.name: alpine_s3_title
data.value: User Interface (UI) & User Experience (UX)

data.name: alpine_s3_p1
data.value: The interface is designed for rapid comprehension and frictionless navigation, adhering to corporate accessibility standards.

data.name: alpine_s3_li1_title
data.value: HUD Integration:

data.name: alpine_s3_li1_text
data.value: Real-time metrics such as current speed, timer, and distance markers are managed through Unity's Canvas Scaler component, ensuring responsive scaling across multi-monitor office setups and varying browser resolutions.

data.name: alpine_s3_li2_title
data.value: Menu Architecture:

data.name: alpine_s3_li2_text
data.value: Designed in Figma and ported into Unity using clean UI prefabs, featuring immediate start states, pause functionality for unexpected work interruptions, and instant telemetry feedback summaries.

data.name: gold_title
data.value: 2. Technical Development Report: Gold Throw (Foundever Games)

data.name: gold_s1_title
data.value: Unity Engine Architecture & Physics Pipeline

data.name: gold_s1_p1
data.value: Gold Throw focuses on precise projectile mechanics, requiring robust mathematical modeling within Unity's physics engine.

data.name: gold_s1_li1_title
data.value: Trajectory Prediction & Ballistics:

data.name: gold_s1_li1_text
data.value: Custom C# algorithms calculate parabolic arcs in real-time, factoring in initial launch velocity, angle vectors, and simulated environmental drag.

data.name: gold_s1_li2_title
data.value: Collision Detection & Scoring Triggers:

data.name: gold_s1_li2_text
data.value: Mesh colliders and trigger volumes are optimized using Layer Collision Matrices to isolate target zones, ensuring instant and accurate hit detection upon projectile impact.

data.name: gold_s1_li3_title
data.value: State Management:

data.name: gold_s1_li3_text
data.value: A centralized Game Manager script oversees round progression, score persistence, and win/loss state transitions with minimal execution latency.

data.name: gold_s2_title
data.value: Visual Art & 3D Asset Pipeline

data.name: gold_s2_p1
data.value: The aesthetic direction of Gold Throw centers on high-contrast visual feedback and satisfying material interaction.

data.name: gold_s2_li1_title
data.value: Texturing & Material Economy:

data.name: gold_s2_li1_text
data.value: Assets are modeled with clean topology and mapped using compressed texture atlases to ensure rapid asset loading times across global company networks.

data.name: gold_s2_li2_title
data.value: Visual Effects (VFX):

data.name: gold_s2_li2_text
data.value: Particle systems built with Unity's Particle System module generate impactful visual feedback upon scoring (e.g., metallic sheen sparks, golden particle bursts) optimized for high performance.

data.name: gold_s2_li3_title
data.value: Animation & Rigging:

data.name: gold_s2_li3_text
data.value: Skeletal hierarchies and simple transform animations are driven by lightweight animator controllers, ensuring fluid motion transitions for throwing mechanics.

data.name: gold_s3_title
data.value: User Interface (UI) & User Experience (UX)

data.name: gold_s3_p1
data.value: The UI framework for Gold Throw prioritizes competitive engagement and immediate readability.

data.name: gold_s3_li1_title
data.value: Interactive HUD Elements:

data.name: gold_s3_li1_text
data.value: Score counters, wind/modifier indicators, and attempt trackers are positioned according to visual hierarchy principles tested in Figma, reducing cognitive load for players during brief pause intervals.

data.name: gold_s3_li2_title
data.value: Feedback Loops:

data.name: gold_s3_li2_text
data.value: Clear visual cues, haptic-style screen shakes (via camera position interpolations), and dynamic color changes provide immediate reinforcement of user actions, contributing to an engaging and stress-relieving user experience.
